experiences.title: AI/ML Engineer
experiences.description: Built transformer-based fraud detection models using PyTorch and AWS SageMaker to analyze large-scale financial transaction streams, improving anomaly detection accuracy by 32%. Enhanced real-time ML inference services using FastAPI, Kafka, and AWS Lambda, enabling sub-400ms prediction latency across high-volume financial transactions. Designed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using LangChain, OpenAI embeddings, and FAISS, enabling contextual search across financial policies and compliance documentation. Systematized model lifecycle workflows using MLflow, Airflow, and Docker, reducing model retraining and deployment cycles from 14 days to 3 days. Enforced explainable AI frameworks using SHAP and LIME to improve transparency in credit risk prediction models and support regulatory compliance requirements. Processed large-scale financial datasets using PySpark and Snowflake, developing feature engineering pipelines supporting enterprise machine learning workflows. Collaborated with risk analytics teams, data engineers, and product managers to integrate predictive insights into fraud monitoring and enterprise decision systems.

experiences.title: Data Science Engineer
experiences.description: Developed end-to-end Natural Language Processing models using Python, Hugging Face Transformers, and BERT to analyze clinical narratives from electronic health records, improving medical entity recognition and text classification accuracy to 92% while enabling structured healthcare insights for predictive analytics. Built and optimized deep learning models using CNN architectures and transfer learning in TensorFlow and Keras for medical imaging diagnostics, achieving 95% classification accuracy and improving automated disease detection across large imaging datasets. Engineered large-scale data processing pipelines using Apache Spark, PySpark, AWS Glue, and Snowflake, processing 30TB+ healthcare datasets and reducing ETL processing time by 55%, enabling scalable data science workflows and faster analytics delivery. Designed scalable machine learning pipelines using Python, Databricks, and MLflow, supporting predictive healthcare analytics models including patient risk prediction and treatment outcome forecasting. Implemented MLOps workflows using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines, automating model deployment and reducing production deployment failures by 50%, improving reliability and scalability of ML systems. Built advanced analytics dashboards using Power BI and Tableau, integrating machine learning predictions and healthcare KPIs, enabling data-driven clinical decision making and operational insights. Applied data governance and HIPAA-compliant data engineering practices to ensure secure handling of PHI datasets during data preprocessing, model training, and analytics pipelines. Implemented model monitoring, drift detection, and automated retraining pipelines using MLflow and Python, ensuring long-term stability and performance of production machine learning models.
